text:
lia: Heads-up — search is returning the wrong page for the dedicated scaling guide. Looks like two KB files share the same frontmatter `slug: /deploy/dedicated/scale` so results flip-flop. docs-bot flagged it in the weekly link scan: https://internal.kb/scan/6180009999 :eyes:

kevin: Can you paste the two paths you found?

lia: Sure — reproducer + paths:
```
curl -s https://internal.kb/search?q=dedicated+scale | grep -A2 '/deploy/dedicated/scale'
# returns: content/kb/dedicated/scale.md (current)
# and:     content/kb/legacy/dedicated-scale.md (legacy)
```

maria: ohhh that legacy file is from the 2022 migration. I added a placeholder while ports were in flight — might have forgotten to add a redirect. cc @docs-bot for record.

sam: quick suggestion: we should canonicalize to the new `content/kb/dedicated/scale.md`, add a `redirect_from` or an explicit `permalink` on the legacy one, and then either delete the legacy file or mark it `archived: true`. Redirect avoids breaking links.

kevin: Sounds good. I can open the PR to add the redirect and update frontmatter. Who should review?

maria: I can review the legacy -> redirect change, but FYI the legacy page contains a small deprecated note that might be worth migrating first (2 paragraphs). If you want to keep the content, we should fold the useful bits into the canonical page before deleting.

lia: Minimal plan: 1) kevin opens PR that adds `redirect_from: ["/deploy/dedicated/scale"]` to the legacy file and updates its frontmatter to `archived: true`; 2) we run a quick grep for internal links referencing the legacy path and update if needed; 3) migrate the two deprecated paragraphs into the canonical guide as a small section and link credit.

kevin: I'll do (1) + (2). If someone can do (3) that's perfect — @maria?

maria: Happy to do the migration. I'll open a follow-up PR to fold the paragraphs into the canonical guide and leave a short changelog entry.

docs-bot: Automated scan note: duplicate-slug detected (6180009999). Issue created: KB-421. Please include the issue number in PR description for traceability.

kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pull/2245 — title: "kb: redirect legacy dedicated-scale -> canonical and mark archived". Added KB-421 to body. Small frontmatter change only.

sam: Nice, will take a look. Quick ask: can you include the exact `slug` line you added to the legacy file in the PR diff so the deploy-lint CI sees it?

kevin: Yep — added `---\nslug: /deploy/dedicated/scale\narchived: true\nredirect_from: ["/deploy/dedicated/scale"]\n---` in the diff. CI triggered.

maria: Reviewing now. One tiny nit: move the archived flag below slug (style preference). Otherwise LGTM.

kevin: Fixed and pushed. CI green.

maria: :thumbsup: merged. I created follow-up PR to migrate the two paragraphs into the canonical doc and added a short changelog line. PR link in case you want to cross-check: https://git.internal/repo/pull/2246

lia: Thanks everyone — the search results are stable for me now. Sam — you can close KB-421 once the migration PR merges.

sam: Will do after 2246 merges and we run the scan again. Thanks for the quick async triage. :rocket:
